comments.text: This battle theme is connected not to a character but to a location. And it uses musical instruments rather than working actual alarm sounds into the composition like the Lobotomy Corporation Warning tracks do, but the same musical idea is still easy to hear. While Limbus Company itself has already remixed LobCorp's original First Warning, this track could be considered its equivalent the same way that Library of Ruina has its own First Warning track.
